# BackdropManager

> **File:** `services/ui/BackdropManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

The dim backgrounds full-screen surfaces ask for (the overlay, launcher, power menu, workspace overview, onboarding: reusable/BackdropRequest). Each screen has one backdrop window (surfaces/backdrop/ScreenBackdrop, built by shell/Backdrops), showing the request that showed last there. One window rather than one per surface keeps it in its place in the stack where the compositor stacks by map order alone: it stays mapped there (docs/dev/compositor/layer-arrangement.md). Without a native focus grab, the same windows catch the click outside a grabbing surface (FocusGrab, `catching`).

### Properties

- `catching` (readonly bool)

### Signals

- `clickedOutside()`

### Functions

- `register()`
- `update(uid, request)`: A request's state, again whenever it changes; null once it's gone
- `requestOn(screenName)`: What the backdrop on `screenName` shows: the request shown there last, or null when none is
- `catchClicks(uid, on)`
